note: The Logic assets this repository treats as source of truth, and what each can answer. A source is listed here only after something measured what it contains; the counts are from Scripts/logic_canon.py build against the Logic in MANIFEST.json. Every count here is printed by `Scripts/logic_canon.py census`; do not retype one.

quickhelp.answers: the identity of a CONTROL, as a key that is the same in every locale
quickhelp.distinct_files_note: en, it, pt and zh_TW ship the same bytes (sha256 3ed7aa22...), so it, pt and zh_TW are untranslated English. A claim of agreement 'across ten locales' counts three agreements that are true by construction.
quickhelp.reaches_live_axhelp: measured: a composition of Title and Text is the SUFFIX of a live AXHelp value on 86 of 114 distinct ko-KR readings
limits: 3766 of 9835 ko keys share their composition with another key, so a string identifies a SET of keys and not always one
the ja and zh_CN join rule is unverified and their punctuation argues against it -- see LOCALE_JOIN_CONFIDENCE in Scripts/logic_canon.py
93 of 9835 keys have ever been confirmed live across every census this repository holds
quickhelp.corpus_files_note: QuickHelp.plist and QuickHelpDefault.plist in each of ten .lproj. The key and distinct-file counts below describe QuickHelp.plist only; QuickHelpDefault.plist is distinct in all ten locales and is counted in `entries`.

strings.answers: the text of a LABEL, which is weaker than a control identity because labels are reused
strings.reaches_live_axhelp: measured: 27 of the 28 live ko-KR AXHelp values QuickHelp cannot explain resolve here, all of them in Logic.framework and none in any other framework
limits: English is structurally absent from 97 of 135 tables that back a live match: en text lives inside Base.lproj nibs and only translated locales get a .strings overlay. A resolver keyed on <locale>.lproj/<name>.strings silently loses en.
across the nine non-English locales, 135 measured tables showed zero key-set drift
a value may be present in the table and NOT used by the interface: the live UI shows untranslated 'German' and 'MIDI Region' although ko translations for both keys exist

The AXHelp resolver reads three Logic.framework tables, not all 2,538 files, so 'none in any other framework' is true of what it looked at. Checked separately against every ko .lproj table in the bundle and it still held, but the code could not have found otherwise.

madsp.answers: a stock plug-in's parameter table: parameterID, name, control type
limits: not localised: the parameter names are fixed in the plist and the ten Localizable.strings beside them hold 23 error and side-chain strings with no parameter names in them

parameterID is an ordinal private to each plug-in, not a global identifier, and 57 of the 124 tables that emit one have gaps in it. An earlier revision said 55 of 127, a figure nothing in the tree derives; `Scripts/logic_canon.py census` prints what does.
nothing measured connects a parameterID to an element in the live accessibility tree

nib.answers: which SCREEN FILE holds a control, by the qhid runtime attribute
limits: 619 distinct qhid values reach 587 QuickHelp keys, which is 6.0% of 9835; 32 point at keys QuickHelp does not have
coverage is concentrated in Preferences and Song Settings (PFS 93%, SET 89%) and is zero for TRA, ARR, SPE, SEQ, LLP, CSS, MIX and INS -- the main window
zero coverage of the 6056 numeric-triple and other keys: plug-in editors are not built from nibs
only 1 of the 86 live QuickHelp-matched controls carried a qhid, so this is a static asset link and not a live control identifier

nibstrings.answers: the ENGLISH text of a LABEL, at the same (unit, key) its translations use
nibstrings.why: Apple uses base internationalization: the English is compiled into `Base.lproj/<table>.nib` and only the translated locales get a `<locale>.lproj/<table>.strings` overlay. Measured: of the 162 Base.lproj nibs that carry labels, ZERO have an `en.lproj/<table>.strings` beside them, so `strings` had no English for any of them and an absence claim over English was answered by a corpus that had never held it.
nibstrings.how: Read from the archive's CLASSES, not guessed from what the strings look like: Interface Builder emits the English as an `NSLocalizableString` object and the `.strings` key for it as the NEXT object, an `NSString`. 6,270 pairs from 162 nibs with zero objects that did not follow the rule; a shape the reader cannot pair stops the build rather than becoming an absence.
nibstrings.joins_strings: measured: against each of the nine translated locales, 6,188 of the overlay's 6,216 keys are also in the nib and NOT ONE key is nib-only; 146 of 159 tables are key-identical. So the unit here is the overlay's own address and English lands in the same table as its translations. `TRANSLATION_NAMESPACE` in Scripts/logic_canon.py is what makes the join happen when deriving which English Apple translates.
limits: The 28 keys the overlay has and the nib does not are Interface Builder's numeric placeholders (`255`, `100`, `30.0`, `1`) and two literal `<PLACEHOLDER STRING: DO NOT LOCALIZE>` -- text held for a field the running code fills in, not a label Apple shows.

Three of the 162 nibs -- MAGraphPanel, NoteRepeater and PlugInManager, all in MAToolKitHighLevel.framework -- have no `.strings` overlay in any locale. Their unit names a table that does not exist on disk, which is the address the overlay WOULD use; the English is real and the screen is not translated.

Base.lproj ONLY. Logic also ships 60 nibs per locale in the old fully-localized style (including `en.lproj`) and 407 nibs in no `.lproj` at all, 312 of them MAPlugInGUI plug-in screens. `NSLocalizableString` is a base-internationalization construct and those 467 nibs have zero of them, so this extractor yields nothing from them. Their labels are plain `NSString` under cell titles, and reading THOSE would also sweep in Interface Builder's own defaults -- `Item 1`, `Header Text`, `DO NOT LOCALIZE`, `$LN` -- which would make the corpus claim Apple ships strings Apple does not show. Measured before deciding: those 467 nibs hold 3,374 distinct English values not already here and close ZERO of this repository's 102 uncitable literals, so they are named here as a gap rather than added on a filter nothing had measured. Issue #902.
Presence is not use, the same as for `strings`: a label compiled into a nib may belong to a screen the running code never shows.

not_canonical.help_book: Contents/Info.plist declares CFBundleHelpBookFolder=logic.help and that folder is on no disk here. Anchor resolves only over the network, at support.apple.com/guide/logicpro/<anchor>/mac, so an Anchor-to-screen mapping is not a local canonical fact.
not_canonical.content_databases: ContentDatabaseV01.db, index.db-fts and PackageContents.dbz are a content catalogue, a search index and an install manifest. Their label columns are empty (ZLABEL 0 of 533) or absent, and they carry no interface strings.
not_canonical.keymap_momd: MAKeymap.framework's Keymap_CD.momd is the Sampler's zone and group model, not key commands. The name invites the opposite reading.
